== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ミレニアム・ファルコン</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを2名、乗客を2名まで乗せられる。ハン、チューイーかランドが操縦していれば、耐：損耗&lt;5を得る。ドッキング能力を持つ。パイロットがいなければ、戦闘力、回避値、航行速度を使えない。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">YT-1300貨物船の改造版。ランド・カルリシアンがサバックの賭で負けて、ハンに譲った。全長26.7メートル。「見てくれは悪いが、中身はすごいんだぜ！」</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Millennium Falcon</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>A modified YT-1300 freighter. Lando Calrissian lost a sabacc bet and handed it over to Han. Overall length 26.7 meters. "It may look bad, but it's amazing inside!"</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>May carry 2 pilots and up to 2 passengers. If Han, Chewie or Lando is piloting, gains immunity to attrition &lt;5. Has docking capability. Without a pilot, cannot use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.</blockquote>

== Comparison with the original English printing ==
The Japanese lore describes [[Lando Calrissian]] losing the sabacc bet and handing the ship to [[Han Solo]], while the original English describes ownership until Han won it. The Japanese calls the docking capability ドッキング能力, while the English says "ship-docking capability." Both printed game texts require a pilot to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed; neither assigns zero to those printed statistics when unpiloted.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-original-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-millenniumfalcon.gif|Original English Millennium Falcon face]].</ref>

'''Original English lore'''
<blockquote>Modified YT-1300 freighter. Owned by Lando Calrissian until won by Han in a sabacc game. 26.7 meters long. "She may not look like much, but she's got it where it counts."</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

'''Original English game text'''
<blockquote>May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 5 if Han, Chewie or Lando piloting. Has ship-docking capability. Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.</blockquote><ref name="english-original-face" />

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
